pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular dark brown polygonal patches with moderately diffuse edges. Upper flank patches exhibit larger spatial area and higher angularity; lower flank patches decrease in area and transition to more sub-circular morphologies.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological network of light-toned pathways. Intersection nodes are primarily trivalent. Pixel thickness of corridors is narrowest on the upper flank and increases toward the ventral regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short upright mane along the upper neck profile showing a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background.
